title: State of a feature plan run (RFC-0008 section 5): .a2dlc/run/_plan/<feature>/state.json
description: What `a2dlc plan run` leaves after each invocation. Each slice runs as an ordinary a2dlc run on a base that is the feature's base with the passed candidates of its dependencies merged. A slice that ends escalated or failed blocks every slice that depends on it, and nothing else. The outcome is PASS only when every slice passed and the merge of all candidates passed a final check against the feature's base. The rules and invariants are in docs/STATE_MACHINE.md.

plan_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the plan file the state belongs to: a changed plan is a new plan run.

merged.description: The commit with every passed candidate merged, once every slice passed.

replans.description: How many times a slice of this feature was decomposed again after its Builders were exhausted (CB-02b); bounded by plan run --max-replan.

acceptance.description: What let this plan run (RFC-0008 section 4): a person's signed approval or an authorization that covers plan.accept. plan run refuses without one; a2dlc verify-run --plan checks it again. Absent in states written before section 4 was implemented, which verify-run --plan rejects.

plan_approval.title: Approval of a plan (.a2dlc/run/_plan/<feature>/approval.json)
plan_approval.description: An SSH signature (ssh-keygen -Y sign, namespace a2dlc-plan) made by a person over the text a2dlc-plan/1, then plan_sha256, base_ref and expires_at, one per line, each line ended by a newline. A plan edited after approval has another plan_sha256 and no longer matches.

at.description: When plan run used it: it must not have expired by then.

authorization.description: The whole signed authorization, decision plan.accept and target plan::<feature_id>, the base the plan runs on.

scheduler.description: How many slices the last invocation ran at once and why: measured on the host that runs a2dlc and on the Docker daemon that runs the containers (with Docker Desktop, its VM), against the peak a slice declares through config.json and roles.json. jobs is what was used; requested is the --jobs or A2DLC_PLAN_JOBS that overrode the measurement, null when it did not.

base.description: The commit the slice's run started from.

candidate.description: The candidate commit of a passed slice.

finished_in.description: The invocation that last ran it (0: never).

definition_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the slice as the plan declares it. A new version of the plan (a replan) keeps the state of a slice whose definition, and that of every slice it depends on, did not change; any other slice starts pending.

run_dir.description: The folder of the slice's a2dlc run (in its own worktree), where a person reads and answers an escalation. Null before it ran.
